title: The Fighting Cocks and the Eagle
summary: Across the rocky pastures and olive orchards of ancient Greece, a memorable encounter unfolded.. Facing a decisive turning point, the characters discover that pride goes before destruction; the loud boaster attracts the eagle’s claws.
